decisive_spans.text: Acute pruritic skin eruption with vesicles and erythema following sun exposure

response.rationale: D2 is supported by the acute pruritic skin eruption with vesicles and erythema following sun exposure. D1 is also supported by the presence of erythema, helical thickening, and numerous small blisters on both ears, but it is contradicted by the intensely pruritic skin eruption.
